summary_title: Meridian Agent Assist Knowledge Command Center
executive_summary: Meridian is exploring AI Agent Assist for Member Service. Nexus has source-backed context across business functions, systems, data assets, risks, metrics, and target architecture. The context is strong enough for enterprise orientation, discovery, chartering, and current-state diagnosis, but it is not enough to claim production readiness, certified AWS/Databricks foundation, PHI-bearing transcript ingestion, or realized value.
strategic_priorities: Improve member service experience with safe, evidence-backed Agent Assist.
Modernize the healthcare analytics foundation from on-premise-heavy reporting and marts toward a governed AWS + Databricks target architecture.
Create measured value discipline before approving production AI or Tower outcome claims.

top_insights.title: Agent Assist is cross-functional, not a standalone chatbot.
top_insights.what_nexus_sees: Member Service depends on contact center, CRM/member-service, claims, eligibility, knowledge, data, controls, and metrics.
top_insights.why_it_matters: The work should move through governed discovery and Moves phases before production design.
top_insights.next_action: Run a Member Service current-state diagnosis with operations, data, platform, privacy, and measurement owners.

top_insights.title: Systems are known, but integration/API readiness is still a gate.
top_insights.what_nexus_sees: CRM, contact center, claims, eligibility, knowledge, Epic reporting context, SQL Server marts, Tableau, and SAS are visible in the landscape.
top_insights.why_it_matters: Agent Assist answer quality depends on live or governed integration paths, not merely system names.
top_insights.next_action: Validate integration method, API readiness, owner, refresh cadence, and access controls for each required system.

top_insights.title: AWS + Databricks is target-state foundation, not current production.
top_insights.what_nexus_sees: The future-state data foundation should include AWS, Databricks, medallion architecture, governed data products, catalog, lineage, and controls.
top_insights.why_it_matters: The case study should show Nexus guiding the foundation direction instead of pretending it already exists.
top_insights.next_action: Validate landing-zone, network, security, Databricks, catalog, PHI, and platform-operations readiness.
top_insights.module_handoff: Moves design and Source platform scope

top_insights.title: Metrics exist as categories, but baselines must be validated.
top_insights.what_nexus_sees: AHT, FCR, transfer rate, repeat contacts, CSAT, quality, compliance, and cost per contact are relevant to Agent Assist.
top_insights.why_it_matters: Tower can define the measurement plan now, but cannot claim realized value without baselines and actuals.
top_insights.next_action: Load baseline extracts and define measurement cadence before executive value claims.

top_insights.title: PHI, HITL, audit, and knowledge governance are gating controls.
top_insights.what_nexus_sees: Healthcare Agent Assist requires privacy, consent/retention, audit logging, human review, hallucination controls, and knowledge freshness.
top_insights.why_it_matters: Control gaps should block production design even when the business case is attractive.
top_insights.next_action: Validate PHI handling, transcript governance, HITL workflow, audit logging, and knowledge article approval process.
top_insights.module_handoff: Moves gate criteria and Intelligence caveats

Frame, charter, and diagnose Agent Assist before future-state design.
Identify likely vendor/platform dependencies; load contracts before optimization claims.

safe_claims: This is synthetic Meridian-style demo context, not real Meridian production data.
Nexus has source-backed context for discovery, chartering, and current-state diagnosis.
AWS and Databricks are represented as a target-state foundation, not a certified current production platform.
Agent Assist is ready for evidence planning and phase-gated execution framing, not production launch.
do_not_claim: Do not claim real Meridian production data was loaded.
Do not claim AWS or Databricks is certified current production for this tenant.
Do not claim realized ROI, Tower value, or savings until measured evidence exists.
Do not claim PHI-bearing transcripts have been ingested or approved.
Do not treat candidate or generated graph rows as approved active tenant truth.
